acceptance_results.evidence: git status and git diff in the seeded run directory show no change after the run.

All three named risks handled concretely: revocation via credential_id/version checked before final ALLOW with revocation writes committed to the strongly consistent store before success is reported and no caller-side allow-cache initially; drift bounded by monotonic per-tenant versions, min_policy_version with INDETERMINATE(STALE_PROJECTION) on lag, and an interface-level conformance corpus with golden cases (time rules, group cycles, tenant isolation, explicit-deny precedence); audit continuity via authoritative-only canonical events in a durable outbox, decision_id dedupe, shadow results kept out of the compliance log, and an explicit rule never to rewrite existing audit IDs, retention, or order.

Cutover and rollback operate per tenant × caller type × action cohort with explicit authority flags; decision authority and audit authority flip together; the local projection is kept current throughout the rollback window and reverse-replication must be healthy before rolling back after write-ownership transfer. Emergency fail-open is confined to a break-glass procedure with a pre-approved read-only action list, short expiry, and dedicated audit events.
